fix.payoffMeterTitle: What this change is measured to help with — not a promised number
fix.gameModeRevertedNote: You applied this before, but Windows switched Game Mode back off. That's your GPU's recording software (AMD Adrenalin / NVIDIA ShadowPlay) resetting it at login — not Compy. Re-applying works, but it'll reset again after the next restart.
fix.gameModeAmdNote: Heads up: on AMD systems, Radeon Adrenalin tends to switch Windows Game Mode back off after you log in (a known Windows/AMD Game Bar conflict). Compy can turn it on, but it may not stay on across reboots — that's the system resetting it, not a Compy bug.

fix.revertsFallback: Compy captures the exact prior state before changing anything, and restores it on rollback.
fix.debloatFailed: Couldn't turn that off — it may need an admin OK, or the prompt was cancelled. Nothing changed; try again.
fix.telemetryTasksIntro: Disable Microsoft telemetry scheduled tasks for this PC — reversible (re-enable from History). Compy only ever touches this curated list; never Defender or anything that breaks Windows.

forceHpet.name: Force HPET
forceHpet.why: On modern Windows this almost always raises latency and causes stutter — the OS already picks the best timer.

pagefileDisable.name: Disable the pagefile
pagefileDisable.why: Games that commit more memory than your RAM hard-crash with it off — leave it system-managed.

disableDefender.name: Disable Windows Defender
disableDefender.why: The FPS gain is a rounding error; the cost is your only always-on protection — and some anti-cheats react badly.

receiptsConsent.title: Share your receipts (opt-in)
receiptsConsent.hint: Off by default, anonymous by design. If you opt in, Compy shares only measured outcomes — your hardware class and session numbers, never your name, paths, or anything that identifies this PC. You can see exactly what would be sent, below, before anything ever leaves this PC.
receiptsConsent.destination: If you turn it on, a receipt goes to one address we run — {{endpoint}} — and nowhere else. No analytics company, no ad network, no account.
receiptsConsent.switchOn: On. After a monitored session, Compy sends one anonymous receipt to {{endpoint}}. Turn it off any time and it stops.
receiptsConsent.switchOff: Off. Nothing about your PC or your sessions is sent.
